messages:
maya (Design): Dropping a trimmed mock for the private setup preflight. Main changes: single-line probe rows, inline one-liners about impact, and a tiny 'Why this matters' link that opens contextual tips. Screenshot attached. Feedback?

jon (PM): Mostly great. Two quick asks: 1) change microcopy to be explicit about impact on install (eg 'Blocks agent install' not just 'May fail'); 2) add a one-click copy for the debug commands.

lee (Eng): Copy button is easy. For the status words I suggest 'Reachable / Partial / Blocked' so it's clear to infra teams. We'll also add aria-live="polite" for live updates.

ara (DevEx): UX suggestion: collapse the legend by default and show a small "Show legend" link. Also make the 'Why this matters' trigger keyboard-focusable and announceable with an aria-expanded state.

a11y-bot: Automated note: current amber color ratio 3.1:1. Needs adjustment to meet 4.5:1. Also recommend adding shape differences (circle/triangle/stop) and visible text labels so color alone isn't the only signal.

maya (Design): OK I'll darken amber and swap label wording to Reachable/Partial/Blocked. Will add shape variations in the icon set and ensure labels are visible.

jon (PM): For the inline tips, keep remediation steps short and vendor-agnostic, then link to vendor-specific docs in the aside. Example: "If blocked: open port 22 to control-plane IPs" + a tiny copy button.

lee (Eng): Implementation note: use role="status" on each probe container and include aria-describedby pointing to the remediation paragraph. Example snippet in the PR.

ara (DevEx): Draft QA checklist:
- legend collapsed by default
- status shows shape + color + text
- amber/darker color meets 4.5:1
- copy buttons keyboard accessible and have aria-labels
- aria-live announces "<probe>: <status>"
- 'Why this matters' toggle has aria-expanded and focus lands in aside

maya (Design): Thanks folks. I'll update the mock and add focused annotations for keyboard order and copy-button states (copied/failed). Will tag the PR when ready. :sparkles:
